scope: Proposition 4.4 (Existence and uniform bounds for minimizers) of the manuscript “Fujita's freeness conjecture” (preprints/Fujitas-freeness-conjecture-September-23-2026/Fujitas-freeness-conjecture-September-23-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 038 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 73aefa0b0e5578df), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that P is not generated at x. For the constants and ranges in Lemma 4.2, fm,t(x) satisfies (4.3) and is attained by an ordered basis of Rm and a nonzero real-weight monomial test on a projective log resolution of the divisors of that basis. Every minimizing test has a∗ ≤ A(v) ≤ a∗ . More generally the same bounds hold eventually along every minimizing sequence. In particular, the positive lower bound a∗ is independent of m ≥ m0 and t ∈ [t0, n + 1].
